item.title: JWT Attack
item.author: quactv
item.description: What is JWT The full name of JWT is Json Web Token. It follows the JSON format and encodes user information into the token. The server doesn’t store any user information, only the key information, and it verifies the token using a specific encryption algorithm and verifies the user’s identity through the token. Token-based authentication can replace the traditional cookie + session authentication method. JWT consists of three parts: header.
